title: Man is struck by lightning on Central Coast
transcript:
Speaker 0: This is Alison Osborne with your News twenty four update.
Speaker 0: A man is fighting for his life after being hit by lightning at a beach on the Central Coast.
Speaker 0: It is understood that the man in his twenties had been swimming at Ettelong Beach on the Central Coast of New South Wales.
Speaker 0: Witnesses say the lightning strike came completely out of nowhere on Saturday afternoon.
Speaker 0: Bystanders
Speaker 0: performed CPR on the man after he was pulled from the water.
Speaker 0: He was later transported
Speaker 0: to Gosford Hospital and remains in a critical condition.
Speaker 0: New South Wales police have charged 260

Speaker 0: trains and 52 buses during the crackdown in October,

Speaker 0: aging analogue routers.

Speaker 0: should not be done as a patchwork.

Speaker 0: began to capsize
